title: Rent Posting and Proration Standard — Apartment Home Lease Ledger
content:
This accounting standard governs how base rent is posted to the Apartment Home Lease ledger.

## Standard

**R1 Status.** Rent posts only while the lease is active, in default or eviction filed. The status is read from the lease record at the time of posting.

**R2 Monthly posting.** On the floor plan's rent due day of every calendar month in possession, one base rent line posts for that month, equal to the monthly rent in force on that day. Its days billed and its days in period both equal the actual days of the month.

**R3 Move-in month.** At move-in one prorated rent line posts for the move-in month:
- its days billed count the days from the move-in date through the last day of the month, both inclusive;
- its days in period are the actual number of days in that month (the floor plan's proration method, actual days in month);
- its amount is the monthly rent multiplied by the days billed and divided by the days in period, rounded half up to the cent.

A move-in on the due day posts a base rent line instead of a prorated rent line.

**R4 Second month at move-in.** When the move-in day is on or after the floor plan's second-month collection day, the following month's base rent line also posts on the move-in date.

**R5 Move-out.** Rent is never prorated at move-out: the full base rent of the month in which possession ends is owed. Any settlement for the days after an early departure belongs to the Lease Term Agreement charter.

**R6 One line per code.** Only one rent line of each charge code — base rent or prorated rent — posts for a billing period. The check is made against the lines already on the ledger for the same lease and billing period.

**R7 Rent changes.** A rent change or unit transfer takes effect from the first billing period whose due date is on or after its effective date; rent already posted is not re-rated.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Move-in date | Monthly rent | Lines posted at move-in |
|---|---|---|
| 18 April | $1,860.00 | Prorated rent for April: 13 days billed (18 through 30 April), 30 days in period, $1,860.00 multiplied by 13 and divided by 30 is $806.00 |
| 1 June | $2,100.00 | A base rent line for June of $2,100.00 (move-in on the due day) |
| 26 July | $1,550.00 | Prorated rent for July: 6 days billed (26 through 31 July), 31 days in period, $1,550.00 multiplied by 6 and divided by 31 is $300.00; and the August base rent line of $1,550.00, because the 26th is on or after the second-month collection day |

**Boundary on the collection day.** With the second-month collection day on the 25th, a move-in on the 25th brings the next month's base rent forward; a move-in on the 24th does not.

**Rent change mid-month (hypothetical).** A new rent effective on the 15th of March first applies to the April base rent line, because April's due date is the first due date on or after the effective date; the March line already posted stays as posted.
